title: Follow Tyler, the Creator’s story
dek: A chronological path through nine releases. Each chapter explains what came before, what changed, and which three songs make that change easiest to hear.

essential_tracks.title: Bastard
essential_tracks.focus: Hear how the fictional therapy frame introduces the project’s narrative language.

essential_tracks.title: Seven
essential_tracks.focus: Listen for the ambition and provocation driving Tyler’s earliest self-produced work.

essential_tracks.title: Odd Toddlers
essential_tracks.focus: The technique and collective identity place the solo project inside Odd Future’s shared world.

releases.transition: The self-released fictional frame moves onto a larger stage as Odd Future’s visibility rapidly expands.

releases.chapter_title: The private world meets public attention

essential_tracks.title: Goblin
essential_tracks.focus: The opening returns to the character frame, now under the pressure of outside scrutiny.

essential_tracks.title: Yonkers
essential_tracks.focus: This is the clearest point to hear provocation become breakthrough-scale visibility.

essential_tracks.title: She
essential_tracks.focus: Frank Ocean’s appearance shows the collective’s voices beginning to intersect on a larger stage.

releases.transition: With visibility established, Wolf makes room for more melody, arrangement, and reflection without abandoning the fictional setting.

releases.chapter_title: Melody and reflection enter the frame

essential_tracks.title: Jamba
essential_tracks.focus: Start with the confident arrival, then notice how much more expansive the production feels.

essential_tracks.title: Answer
essential_tracks.focus: The writing lets family and unanswered connection sit closer to the surface.

essential_tracks.title: IFHY
essential_tracks.focus: Contradictory attachment becomes both a character study and an arrangement showcase.

releases.transition: That expanding production palette pushes toward Cherry Bomb, where dense arrangement and abrasion become the point.

releases.chapter_title: Push the production until it distorts

essential_tracks.title: DEATHCAMP
essential_tracks.focus: The forceful entrance announces a brighter, louder, more abrasive production language.

essential_tracks.title: FIND YOUR WINGS
essential_tracks.focus: The softer arrangement reveals possibility and mentorship inside the album’s extremes.

essential_tracks.title: SMUCKERS
essential_tracks.focus: Ambition, technique, and major collaborators meet in one of the chapter’s clearest rap showcases.

releases.transition: Cherry Bomb’s density becomes the contrast point for Flower Boy’s more concise, reflective writing and arrangements.

releases.chapter_title: Turn inward without shrinking the world

essential_tracks.title: Where This Flower Blooms
essential_tracks.focus: Growth and self-definition introduce the album’s reflective center.

essential_tracks.title: Garden Shed
essential_tracks.focus: Privacy and disclosure make the album’s greater openness especially clear.

essential_tracks.title: 911 / Mr. Lonely
essential_tracks.focus: Success and loneliness occupy the same song, capturing the chapter’s emotional contrast.

releases.transition: Flower Boy’s reflection becomes an even tighter, character-driven emotional sequence on IGOR.

releases.chapter_title: Let one emotional sequence control the album

essential_tracks.title: EARFQUAKE
essential_tracks.focus: Fear of loss turns the album’s opening movement into a direct plea.

essential_tracks.title: A BOY IS A GUN
essential_tracks.focus: Attraction and danger converge as the relationship triangle tightens.

essential_tracks.title: GONE, GONE / THANK YOU
essential_tracks.focus: Grief and gratitude share the same extended turn toward attempted acceptance.

releases.transition: The continuous relationship narrative gives way to DJ Drama’s mixtape-hosted travel world while Tyler keeps the careful sequencing.

releases.chapter_title: Travel outward while conflict stays private

essential_tracks.title: CORSO
essential_tracks.focus: The confident arrival establishes the hosted mixtape language and public-facing scale.

essential_tracks.title: WUSYANAME
essential_tracks.focus: Invitation and attraction bring warmth into the travel-stamped world.

essential_tracks.title: WILSHIRE
essential_tracks.focus: The extended relationship account exposes the private conflict beneath the album’s luxury and movement.

releases.transition: Public confidence and private conflict move toward questions of adulthood, responsibility, and privacy on CHROMAKOPIA.

releases.chapter_title: Use the mask to talk about visibility

essential_tracks.title: St. Chroma
essential_tracks.focus: The visual persona supplies direction while introducing a more guarded album world.

essential_tracks.title: Noid
essential_tracks.focus: Visibility and privacy become the chapter’s central tension.

essential_tracks.title: Like Him
essential_tracks.focus: Family and resemblance make adult responsibility feel personal rather than abstract.

releases.transition: Guarded reflection shifts into a concise, movement-focused record only nine months later.

releases.chapter_title: End the current path in motion

essential_tracks.title: Big Poe
essential_tracks.focus: The entrance immediately redirects the story toward physical movement.

essential_tracks.title: Sugar on My Tongue
essential_tracks.focus: Desire and dance carry the concise project’s lighter, immediate energy.

essential_tracks.title: Don't Tap That Glass / Tweakin'
essential_tracks.focus: Release and performance close the current reviewed discography in motion.

releases.transition: The reviewed journey currently ends here. You can now explore every track, source, collaborator, and connection without losing the chronology.
